Codex review: blocked before merge. _Reviewed October 8, 2026, 4:37 AM ET / 08:37 UTC._ # ClawSweeper review ## What this changes Doctor preserves plugin-required direct-user target kinds and restores previously stripped kinds from matching config backups. **Example:** Run Doctor with owner discord:user:100000000000000001. - **Before:** Doctor rewrites the owner to discord:100000000000000001, causing owner-targeted heartbeats to skip with no-route. - **After:** Doctor preserves discord:user:100000000000000001 so heartbeat routing identifies a direct-message destination. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | Useful regression coverage supports the direction, but the incomplete persisted-owner cutover breaks established Discord workflows. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Not applicable: The supplied repository state identifies a member-authored area repair, outside the ordinary external-contributor proof gate. Reported validation exercises production routing and disk-backed Doctor through an in-process harness, not the installed updater. Persisted owner compatibility remains insufficient because Discord consumers reject the restored form and the required published-driver upgrade/rollback cell is absent. | | **Patch quality** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | 1 actionable review finding remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Discord heartbeat alerts silently stop after an update rewrites the configured owner's direct-message target. **Reason:** The linked report establishes broken shipped behavior with a clear routing mechanism. Prior area ownership and the author's explanation support the direction without introducing settings or a new plugin API. ## Regression provenance Possible regression — suspected (reviewed change). No predecessor PR is attributed. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 6 items remain** This PR addresses a current shipped regression, but its owner-format cutover is incomplete: preserved or recovered Discord owners still lose voice access and owner-derived exec approvals. **Priority:** P1 **Reviewed head:** `08427b5c2e7dbb8b3d4fb66f73426aad44ffb964` ## Before merge - [ ] **Update Discord owner consumers for the preserved target kind (P1)** - Keeping `discord:user:100000000000000001` here, or restoring it from a backup, now makes that form canonical. However, `resolveDiscordCommandOwnerEntries()` still filters out every `discord:user:` entry at `extensions/discord/src/command-owners.ts:10`. Consequently, Doctor's recovery changes a working bare owner into an empty voice admission list and removes owner-derived exec approvers. Existing voice-command and exec-approval tests explicitly assert these rejections. Update the shared Discord selector and its consumers/tests together so repairing heartbeat routing preserves these existing owner workflows. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - Published-driver × candidate upgrade and rollback compatibility remains unproven; the supplied disk-backed harness does not exercise the installed updater required by repository policy. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - Provide the repository-required published-driver × candidate upgrade/rollback evidence after the owner-consumer repair. - [ ] **Improve patch quality** - Repair the shared Discord owner selector and verify voice access and owner-derived exec approvals after Doctor preservation and recovery. - [ ] **Improve patch quality** - Record a supported published-updater upgrade and rollback against the repaired candidate. - [ ] **Add data-model compatibility proof** - Confirm migration or upgrade compatibility proof before merge. ## Findings - [P1] Update Discord owner consumers for the preserved target kind — `src/commands/doctor-command-owner.ts:57-60` ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: The supplied tests cover routing, core authorization, and Doctor persistence, but omit Discord voice and owner-derived approval consumers after migration. No shipped published-updater upgrade/rollback scenario is supplied; reported baseline failures were not independently executed in this read-only review.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Doctor repairs persisted OpenClaw configuration during maintenance and updates. Configured channel owners feed both heartbeat destinations and privileged command authorization. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Current owner configuration] --> C[Doctor owner migration] B[Existing config backups] --> D[Recorded-kind recovery] E[Channel target contract] --> C E --> D C --> F[Persisted owner configuration] D --> F F --> G[Heartbeat direct-message routing] F --> H[Command and approval authorization] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Complete the typed-owner cutover in Discord's shared selector while retaining native sender matching, direct-only heartbeat admission, and conservative backup recovery. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Yes, from source: main strips the Discord user kind before direct-only heartbeat admission, and the proposed preserved form is rejected by existing Discord owner-consumer tests. No runtime execution was performed during this read-only review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? No, the current patch leaves competing interpretations of the owner format; updating the existing shared Discord selector completes the otherwise appropriate plugin-owned repair. Full review comments: - [P1] Update Discord owner consumers for the preserved target kind — `src/commands/doctor-command-owner.ts:57-60` Keeping `discord:user:100000000000000001` here, or restoring it from a backup, now makes that form canonical. However, `resolveDiscordCommandOwnerEntries()` still filters out every `discord:user:` entry at `extensions/discord/src/command-owners.ts:10`. Consequently, Doctor's recovery changes a working bare owner into an empty voice admission list and removes owner-derived exec approvers. Existing voice-command and exec-approval tests explicitly assert these rejections. Update the shared Discord selector and its consumers/tests together so repairing heartbeat routing preserves these existing owner workflows. Confidence: 0.99 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.98 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [4dc47557f10d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4dc47557f10d6a04c7e21edd295341db4ebc285e). ### Merge-risk options **Maintainer options:** 1. **Complete and verify the owner-format cutover (recommended)** Repair the shared Discord owner selector and record a supported published updater upgrading to the candidate, including owner preservation and rollback. ### Provenance checked - `src/commands/doctor-command-owner.ts` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/137780: Persist legacy owner identities as native sender identities to restore owner-only commands and retire alternate runtime authorization envelopes.) - `src/auto-reply/command-auth.ts` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/140637: Normalize existing Discord sender aliases while retaining Doctor-only migration of retired bundled-channel owner entries.) - `extensions/discord/src/channel.ts and extensions/discord/src/shared.ts` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107953: Declare channel-specific direct-target grammar on the messaging adapter instead of maintaining channel literals in core.) - `docs/tools/slash-commands.md and src/commands/doctor-config-flow.workspace-persistence.test.ts` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/137780: Document and verify canonical owner persistence and an idempotent Doctor repair.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. Added test files: 2. ### Security None. ### Evidence Acceptance criteria: - [P1] pnpm test src/commands/doctor-command-owner-route.test.ts src/commands/doctor-config-flow.workspace-persistence.test.ts --maxWorkers=1. - [P1] pnpm test extensions/discord/src/voice/command.test.ts extensions/discord/src/voice/speaker-context.test.ts extensions/discord/src/exec-approvals.test.ts --maxWorkers=1. - [P1] node scripts/check-changed.mjs. - [P1] git diff --check. What I checked: - **Current main still strips the required kind:** Fetched main retains unconditional channel:user:id normalization. Comparing the merge base with fetched main produced no changes in the central migration or Discord owner selector. ([`src/commands/doctor-command-owner.ts:12`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/4dc47557f10d6a04c7e21edd295341db4ebc285e/src/commands/doctor-command-owner.ts#L12), [4dc47557f10d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4dc47557f10d6a04c7e21edd295341db4ebc285e)) - **Introduced owner-format change:** The introduced migration now keeps user-prefixed owners, and backup recovery writes the same typed form. Shared core command authorization was updated to accept it. ([`src/commands/doctor-command-owner.ts:59`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/08427b5c2e7dbb8b3d4fb66f73426aad44ffb964/src/commands/doctor-command-owner.ts#L59), [08427b5c2e7d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/08427b5c2e7dbb8b3d4fb66f73426aad44ffb964)) - **Discord consumers still reject the new canonical form:** The unchanged shared Discord selector removes every discord:user: entry. Voice access and owner-derived exec approvals consume this selector, so restoring a previously working bare owner makes both lists empty. ([`extensions/discord/src/command-owners.ts:10`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/08427b5c2e7dbb8b3d4fb66f73426aad44ffb964/extensions/discord/src/command-owners.ts#L10), [08427b5c2e7d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/08427b5c2e7dbb8b3d4fb66f73426aad44ffb964)) - **Existing voice behavior confirms the incompatibility:** The existing voice-command case accepts discord:100000000000000001 but rejects discord:user:100000000000000001 with 'You are not authorized to use this command.'. ([`extensions/discord/src/voice/command.test.ts:122`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/08427b5c2e7dbb8b3d4fb66f73426aad44ffb964/extensions/discord/src/voice/command.test.ts#L122), [08427b5c2e7d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/08427b5c2e7dbb8b3d4fb66f73426aad44ffb964)) - **Existing approval behavior confirms the incompatibility:** The existing test explicitly expects zero owner-derived approvers for commands.ownerAllowFrom=['discord:user:123'], while explicit approval targets retain support. ([`extensions/discord/src/exec-approvals.test.ts:104`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/08427b5c2e7dbb8b3d4fb66f73426aad44ffb964/extensions/discord/src/exec-approvals.test.ts#L104), [08427b5c2e7d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/08427b5c2e7dbb8b3d4fb66f73426aad44ffb964)) - **Original migration intent and area history:** The merged https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/137780 deliberately retired channel:user:id runtime ownership while restoring owner-only commands. Its raw commit records a parent, and its patch introduces both the migration and Discord selector; this PR explains the routing reason for revising that contract. ([`extensions/discord/src/command-owners.ts:10`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/8b8fb1ff3b9f6ba3dd9194d23a655ff4a0e92400/extensions/discord/src/command-owners.ts#L10), [8b8fb1ff3b9f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8b8fb1ff3b9f6ba3dd9194d23a655ff4a0e92400)) Likely related people: - **Peter Steinberger:** Raw commit 8b8fb1ff3b9f6ba3dd9194d23a655ff4a0e92400 adds extensions/discord/src/command-owners.ts:10 relative to its recorded parents. This identifies author metadata, not feature responsibility or a PR merger.
